title: vector-field-flow-2d widget params
description: A self-contained 'click to seed a trajectory' engine for 2D autonomous flows. The author supplies a vector field via `function field(x,y){ return {dx, dy}; }` (data coordinates); the engine draws a faint normalised direction field over the plot, and on every click it integrates a streamline through the seed point (RK4, forward and backward) and draws it, reporting where the forward orbit settles. The reader builds up a phase portrait by clicking. The renderer owns the click→data mapping, the RK4 integration, the direction-field grid, trajectory drawing and Reset; the author writes only field(x,y) and an optional decorate(BG) for static overlays (fixed points, nullclines, labels) using the exposed PX(x)/PY(y) data→pixel helpers. The gesture is 'click-seed' — a dimension the corpus otherwise lacks. jsdom-safe: createSVGPoint/getScreenCTM run only inside the click handler, never at init.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper. The Reset button derives its id from it (widgetId+'-reset').

svgId.description: DOM id for the <svg> drawing surface.

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout the author writes-into / the engine reports the seed and fate into.

hint.description: Optional hint in .hd > .hint. Should tell the reader to click in the plane to release a trajectory.

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> inside the SVG. Defaults to title.

x0.description: Data x at the left edge. Default -2.

x1.description: Data x at the right edge. Default 2.

y0.description: Data y at the bottom edge. Default -1.5.

y1.description: Data y at the top edge. Default 1.5.

steps.description: Max integration steps per direction. Default 600.

gridNX.description: Direction-field columns. Default 21. Set 0 to disable the field.

initialSeeds.description: Trajectories drawn at load and restored on Reset, as [x, y] data pairs.

bodyScript.description: Author JS defining `function field(x,y){ return {dx, dy}; }` (the 2D vector field in data coordinates) and, optionally, `function decorate(BG){ ... }` to draw static overlays (fixed points, nullclines, labels) into the background group `BG` using the engine helpers PX(x)/PY(y) (data→pixel) and the page-global $/SVG. Must not start a timer; the engine integrates synchronously on click.
